load_tf_weights_in_gpt2: load TensorFlow checkpoint weights into a PyTorch GPT-2 model from a given checkpoint path
GPT2Model_forward: run the GPT2Model forward pass with input_ids to get hidden states and past key values
GPT2LMHeadModel_forward: run the GPT2LMHeadModel forward pass with input_ids and labels to compute language modeling loss and logits
GPT2DoubleHeadsModel_forward: run the GPT2DoubleHeadsModel forward pass for combined language modeling and multiple choice classification tasks
Attention_prune_heads: prune specified attention heads in the GPT-2 Attention module to reduce model size
